item.text: {"diagnosis":"Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions that produce no observable state change, especially clicks, no-ops, and scrolls.","expected_mechanism":"A retry cap plus mandatory re-observation should convert unproductive loops into diagnosis or strategy changes, improving completion efficiency. Cost: extra state checks and occasional premature stopping when a repeated action might eventually succeed.","policy_text":"After an action yields no observable state change, do not repeat the same or functionally equivalent action more than once. Re-observe state, diagnose the blocker, and switch strategy, target, or tool; if no materially different option exists, stop and report the constraint.","quantitative_evidence":[{"command":"jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.labels.comparison_side[0],.value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{v=$2<0?-$2:$2; n[$1]+=v} END{for(s in n) print s,n[s]}' | sort","finding":"Repeated-result operations: candidate/bad 1,485 versus base/good 224, a +1,261 excess and 6.63× raw count."},{"command":"jq -r '[.labels.comparison_side[0],.value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{v=$2<0?-$2:$2; n[$1]+=v} END{for(s in n) print s,n[s]}' | sort","finding":"All operations: candidate/bad 7,366 and base/good 3,780. Thus repeated results comprise 20.16% versus 5.93% of operations, a 3.40× proportional overrepresentation."},{"command":"jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.labels.comparison_side[0],.labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | sort -u | cut -f1 | sort | uniq -c","finding":"Repeated behavior occurs in 88 candidate/bad source sessions versus 20 base/good source sessions, showing recurrence beyond a few isolated operations."}]}
